source_caption_text:
Bro was not letting her go hungry 😂🔥

Tyler, The Creator’s “WUSYANAME” is one of the standout moments from his 2021 album Call Me If You Get Lost. Built around a sample of H-Town’s “Back Seat (Wit No Sheets),” the track has a smooth, ‘90s R&B feel that fits perfectly with Tyler’s playful delivery. Ty Dolla $ign also adds some silky background vocals, giving the song an even smoother feel.

Tyler spends the track caught up in a new crush, going from funny pickup lines to imagining all the places he could take her. He even starts planning extravagant dates before realizing he hasn’t actually asked for her name. That mix of humor, confidence and genuine romantic excitement is what makes the song so entertaining.

YoungBoy Never Broke Again comes through with an unexpected guest verse, bringing a different energy to the track without throwing off its laid-back feel. At just over two minutes, “WUSYANAME” leaves you wanting more, and it’s still one of the most replayable songs from Call Me If You Get Lost.
